core_obligations: The lower shriek (proof lines 5741-5749): under the identification of the localized categories with the slices, the lower shriek of the second localization is given by composing with the morphism of the site, which follows from the identity of the composites of the lower shrieks.

The pullback (proof lines 5755-5793): the author gives a direct proof by describing the sheaf on the localized site corresponding to an object of the slice and computing the pullback on it, obtaining the fibre product description displayed in the statement, and notes that the result could also be deduced by adjunction from the description of the lower shriek.
proof_roadmap: Use the identification of the localized categories with slices to describe the lower shriek.
Compute the pullback on the sheaf corresponding to an object of the slice.
Read off the two displayed descriptions.
difficulty_reason: The lemma makes explicit, in terms of the identification of the localized categories of sheaves with the slices, the pullback and the lower shriek of the second localization attached to a morphism of the site (statement lines 5715-5738). The proof is a complete computation: the lower shriek is read off from the identity of the composites of the lower shrieks given by the companion result (proof lines 5741-5749); and the pullback is computed directly on the sheaf corresponding to an object of the slice, giving the fibre product description in the statement, with the author noting that the adjunction with the first description gives an alternative argument (proof lines 5755-5793). The non-formal content is the identification of the sheaf corresponding to an object of the slice and the resulting computation. The claim is H2: an explicit computation with each input named.
